set.pl: Noyes 80 acres, SW¼ NW¼ sec. 5 and SE¼ NE¼ sec. 6 T17N R16W (Eden Twp), near Scottville; house mark at the NW corner of the sec. 5 forty on the 5/6 line, about 0.3 mi S of the Custer Twp line (1904 Standard Atlas of Mason County)
set.t: The 300 m circle covers the whole 1904 Noyes 80; the house mark sat at the NW corner of the sec. 5 forty. Look for the old house site and fence lines on the 1938 aerial. Access: private: permission.
pinev: 1904 Standard Atlas of Mason County: Noyes 80 (SW¼ NW¼ sec. 5 + SE¼ NE¼ sec. 6 T17N R16W) with the house mark on the 5/6 line, placed from the BLM PLSS grid; 300 m covers the whole 80
Stays C: both 1935 accounts are wire copies (INS, AP), and that the 1904 Noyes was Fred's father is not proven

set.t: Long shot: the local paper doubted any hoard. The barn loft site is not located. Access: town lots.

tw-mi-homer-laker-cans-1896.st: The local Homer Index (11 Mar 1896, p. 3) doubted there was any hoard: only $88 was found, in a trunk at his half-brother's farm south of Homer.
